fusions.name: Chum Hook
fusions.desc: Costs 6% of your maximum health. Deals 8 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Tightening Circle
fusions.desc: Only strikes a target at or below 25% health. Hurls a drawn line that deals 22 damage, and you heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Thrashing Pass
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Bloodied Waters
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 30% of the damage you deal for 8 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
